Before I go any further, I want to thank Congressman Andy Biggs for his years of service to AZ-5 and wish him well in his decision to step down from this seat and run for Governor of Arizona.

Andy has always fought hard for conservative values, **and you can trust that I will do the same.**

**You know me, and you know my record.** As Sheriff, I spent years on the frontlines — battling the fentanyl epidemic, fighting cartel violence spilling over our borders, rescuing children from trafficking rings, and holding gang members and criminals accountable.

**Every day, I put on my badge and carried the responsibility of keeping our communities safe.** I’ve seen families ripped apart by crime and drugs, and I’ve felt that pain personally. I’ve seen firsthand the devastating effects of rising crime and failing leadership.

**I won’t stand by while career politicians in Washington make excuses, play politics, and leave families unprotected.**

Our liberty, our safety, and our freedom are not guaranteed by silence — they are defended through action. I will fight in Congress for the same principles I’ve lived by as Sheriff: **personal responsibility, faith, courage, and an unwavering commitment to the people I serve.**

I will stand up to the woke left, to the weak political establishment, and to anyone who puts politics above the safety of our communities.

_This fight will not be easy._ Washington isn’t used to someone who tells it like it is, someone who’s willing to get their hands dirty and put people over politics. But that’s exactly what I intend to do — for Arizona families, for our law enforcement, and for our Constitution.

I’m ready to step up and bring real leadership to Congress, but I can’t do it alone. [**Will you stand with me and help me launch this campaign with a generous show of support?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5713e442347b40b8ac3fbd98ee315e49&_e=uXyKx4UEhSj4UrgTlSmOvlMqxEWcE_FiUXeFnzWKYdUamInQUj8Cm8IkuHjW_gZZgt7MMLw11nxhqILnSfbV3vDAf1ZUl9d3tr6lUub7gNs8CykMIqkaJsHM4Q_gVro2_Q192VJCTbbAsVv9kSiftRLHs0hN6ucjmDclSlYxR8vSBLn1h-Cvt11CJsrfJ3s0_CdCbloIHsDdAZobQhuiFQMf8RzC3YAbh-gOVBH_JCnAEA8X71jKzU89DGeiN45hO_veaIH35cQAKOrFHhewZ__tCzz94X_1s5R4WJYE4QyEGGIfbsF8YH4VezqZyJs9sG39-lRPL8o9GmKRCQ7JCMwL0xZ-as0tjoLZ_PQ0pwKLzjr8XggKMPi2C-Qwahp9dkfBTKAey-wruw0NyXQyPBAf3f767PFSN1wkGuzqKvNflCpNTNQadws65-lvITLaFhEY5ht_h7nfleWFzhL5m1OLqWkyRlFpNnf05p9v5e-mC5PCqo2tAO36-7AngEIFKN3vyhGa2-O_xqR_seiCvFN4U-uVXGv9hyPj-eToD22Tvxfvl1rBlLQtoHZ41YMaSlGKN7E0ZeYj4MsMAykxUgz0h-sp9UU2Qz76nZB8hw3wRQM8JT5OgODUQ7n1kAL3YfSDdZrl3m3l0HyauWiMaht7dxelZIdemz787cyUMOM%3D)

clean_body: I’ve never backed down from doing what’s right — even when it wasn’t popular — and I won’t start now. | Fellow patriot — You may already know me – some of you know me and my story well. But I want to take this opportunity to reintroduce myself and share some exciting news. My name is Mark Lamb — I’m a husband, father, God-fearing American, and the proud former Sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona. After much prayer and reflection with my family, I’ve made a huge decision: I am officially running for Congress in Arizona’s 5th District! This isn’t about ambition — it’s about service. I’ve seen what happens when leaders lack courage and conviction, and I refuse to sit by while feckless politicians and bureaucrats fail our nation’s families. I’ve never backed down from doing what’s right — even when it wasn’t popular — and I won’t start now. Before I go any further, I want to thank Congressman Andy Biggs for his years of service to AZ-5 and wish him well in his decision to step down from this seat and run for Governor of Arizona. Andy has always fought hard for conservative values, and you can trust that I will do the same. You know me, and you know my record. As Sheriff, I spent years on the frontlines — battling the fentanyl epidemic, fighting cartel violence spilling over our borders, rescuing children from trafficking rings, and holding gang members and criminals accountable. Every day, I put on my badge and carried the responsibility of keeping our communities safe. I’ve seen families ripped apart by crime and drugs, and I’ve felt that pain personally. I’ve seen firsthand the devastating effects of rising crime and failing leadership. I won’t stand by while career politicians in Washington make excuses, play politics, and leave families unprotected. Our liberty, our safety, and our freedom are not guaranteed by silence — they are defended through action. I will fight in Congress for the same principles I’ve lived by as Sheriff: personal responsibility, faith, courage, and an unwavering commitment to the people I serve. I will stand up to the woke left, to the weak political establishment, and to anyone who puts politics above the safety of our communities. This fight will not be easy. Washington isn’t used to someone who tells it like it is, someone who’s willing to get their hands dirty and put people over politics. But that’s exactly what I intend to do — for Arizona families, for our law enforcement, and for our Constitution. I’m ready to step up and bring real leadership to Congress, but I can’t do it alone. Every contribution — big or small — sends a message: that hard-working families won’t be ignored, that our freedoms matter, and that courage still counts in America. I’m ready, fellow patriot. Are you with me? For God, Family, and Country, Mark Lamb Republican for Congress, AZ-5 P.S. I want to make it clear that the outpouring of support you’ve shown me and my wife, Janel, in the past factored into our decision to make this run. As Sheriff, I couldn’t have accomplished what I did without my deputies, and I won’t be able to succeed in this fight without you. Thank you! subject: Abigail Spanberger

body:
#
We have conditioned ourselves to believe that it is normal for Members of Congress — who swore an oath to the people — to day-trade stocks and make millions of dollars with the sensitive information they are entrusted with.
But **Abigail Spanberger knows: we must do everything we can to restore the American people’s faith in our institutions**.
In Congress, Abigail and I worked with a bipartisan coalition to craft legislation that would ban congressional stock trading and demand better from our leaders.
**Abigail is _still_ demanding better** — and now, she’s running for Governor of Virginia in the only election where we might flip a Governor's office from red to blue this year.
But this week, Trump endorsed her GOP opponent and started attacking Abigail.
[Will you split a $5 contribution — $2.50 for each of our teams — between our two campaigns today so that we can flip Virginia blue and get a working-class champion into office to stand up to Trump’s chaos?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20251024-spanberger.GMl4-n&refcode=em20251024-10056-P_FND_SPL_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10056%2E2526796%2EdSaAMT)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20251024-spanberger.GMl4-n&refcode=em20251024-10056-P_FND_SPL_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=10056%2E2526796%2EdSaAMT)**
Abigail first decided to enter public service when she saw her representative vote to repeal the healthcare coverage of hundreds of thousands of Virginians — and when she did, **Abigail became the first woman ever to represent Virginia’s 7th congressional district, and the first Democrat elected there in over 50 years**.
She led bipartisan efforts that were signed into law to prevent fentanyl overdoses, protect natural resources, and support veterans.
**Abigail is truly a brawler for the working class**. She’s committed to making Virginia more affordable for working-class families, strengthening public schools, and fighting against the division that the Trump administration is sowing in our communities across the country.
[Join us in the fight to flip Virginia to a Democratic Governor today by splitting a $5 contribution between our teams. Every dollar goes a long way.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20251024-spanberger.GMl4-n&refcode=em20251024-10056-P_FND_SPL_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=10056%2E2526796%2EdSaAMT)

Alexandria

October 24, 2025
Many American citizens came out in force to protest the actions of President Trump under the moniker of "No Kings." In my home state of Connecticut, large crowds appeared in our cities and in posh suburbs such as Westport.
According to the [No Kings website](https://substack.com/redirect/9183359d-3241-4368-b90c-18e79a809c27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the protesters are upset about: the targeting [of] immigrant families... Gutting healthcare, environmental protections... [and] Rigging maps to silence voters."
But is President Trump behaving like a king? Or is he merely implementing policies he [articulated during his campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/e98614cb-3b3e-45a3-83ca-e27ec48bcd3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) while winning an election fair and square. Let's look at the issues:
**Targeting of immigrant families**. Anyone who wasn't braindead during the 2024 presidential campaign understood that President Trump was going to deport the millions of illegals that the Biden administration allowed to flood the country. That is exactly what he is doing. No Kings protesters seem to believe no one is above the law except illegal immigrants. If they are unhappy about President Trump's actions, they should be advocating for amnesty for illegal immigrants, but this policy is not suggested on the No Kings website.
**Gutting health care.** Are you serious? The Democrats just shut down the government to shake down the taxpayers for more Obamacare subsidies to enrich insurance company CEOs. There's reason these hucksters are pulling in $30,000,000 a year. And to add insult to injury, Obamacare insurance stinks. Few doctors accept it (I do) because the patients are barely getting by financially but have huge deductibles that they can't afford to pay.
**Environmental Protection**. President Trump made it very clear during his campaign that he considered the Climate Change movement "a hoax." Is it the behavior of a king to stop subsidizing this scam? In Connecticut, the Climate Change movement is so powerful that fossil fuel use has been discouraged to the point that energy prices have skyrocketed. Thus, many homeowners were surprised when the "[Public Benefits Charge](https://substack.com/redirect/07eaad8a-7247-4797-b45c-e01701aa2e3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" was added to their bill. This was necessary because our poorer citizens could not afford the higher bills caused by the Climate Change scam and nobody in the right mind wants our poorer citizens to freeze.

**Rigging maps to silence voters**. Really? President Trump is merely encouraging Red States to play by the same rules the Blue States have used for decades - gerrymandering. In Connecticut, President Trump won 42% of the vote but there are no Republican congressmen. Why? Democratic operatives created the "lobster claw," putting small rural Republican-leaning towns into the heavily Democratic first Congressional district while inserting the Democratic-leaning affluent suburbs of Avon, Farmington and Simsbury into the previously Republican fifth district.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b3d9a515-93ec-42fe-82fd-e431d7f574fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Connecticut "Lobster Claw" gerrymander to give Democrats all five Congressional seats.

In fact, Trump won 40% of the vote in northeastern states but because of gerrymandering, there is not one Republican congressman! The reason the No Kings protesters are upset is that they have already maxed out their gerrymandering and can't cheat anymore.
But that doesn't mean that the No Kings protesters are wrong. But they are protesting the wrong person. Where were they when Joe Biden was President?
As soon as President Trump announced he was running for President again in 2022, the Biden administration choreographed lawfare on President Trump in both Georgia and Manhattan for such heinous crimes as using clever bookkeeping to cover up a tryst with a porn star, inflating real estate assets even though no bank lost a penny on these assessments and charging him with sexually assaulting a women without a scintilla of objective evidence.
Then President Biden sent armed stormtroopers into President Trump's house with orders to "use deadly force if necessary" over a silly argument over classified documents. The attorney, Jack Smith, who was charged with prosecuting President Trump was [illegally appointed](https://substack.com/redirect/b4e539b4-a0df-4e42-ba7f-63cb7163dc36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!
President Biden censored both [Google and Facebook](https://substack.com/redirect/8c7ac996-aca1-429e-a4be-e59b34f7b690?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for posting articles that questioned the efficacy of the administration's COVID policies such as forcing people to wear ineffective masks, six-foot social distancing, and firing people who refused COVID vaccines. He then pardoned the architect of these policies, Dr. Anthony Fauci, from being prosecuted for his obvious perjury.
These were the actions of not only a king, but a tyrannical king.
And then King Biden and his Court coronated Queen Kamala Harris as the Democratic presidential nominee without a vote being cast!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fede4d4c-a000-486b-b015-ca85654f8ee1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yet here in Westport, Connecticut, over [three thousand people protested](https://substack.com/redirect/2a66bd90-adc3-45b7-bb00-1c53be850987?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against President Trump at the No Kings rally.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/190b950e-24fd-4c65-b2ad-6fedac097fb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Suffering Westport Connecticut residents at the No Kings protest
But look at this picture. It consists of lily-white affluent people in designer sunglasses who have never have contact with an illegal immigrant unless he is waiting on them in an upscale restaurant or wearing a leaf blower. Their average home value is over $1,900,000. Their stock portfolios are at record highs. None are insured by Obamacare. Their idea of suffering is drinking an overoaked Cabernet Sauvignon. They are rebels without a cause.
Many of them are former Baby Boomers who author Tom Wolfe labeled as "The Me Generation." And he hit the nail on the head. They drove their parents nuts protesting the Viet Nam War and then drove their children nuts by forcing them to participate in endless extracurricular activities so they could enroll in prestigious colleges. Then the Me Generation increased their social status by bragging about them at cocktail parties. But now they are upset because they are used to everyone kowtowing to them while they get their way.
Instead of ridiculing these people, President Trump should give 20,000 illegal immigrants debit cards and dump them off in Westport, the same way President Biden dumped illegals off in the working-class town of Springfield, Ohio. They could attend the public schools and tool around town in uninsured vehicles getting in fender benders. Then President Trump would get a good laugh as the liberal women of Westport pulled their "Hate Has No Place Here" signs out of their yards and used them to whack the illegals over the head.

Our **hospitals** have shut their doors, our **farmers** face rising costs and shrinking margins, and our**small towns** have lost jobs while politicians in Washington argue on TV. Meanwhile, Marjorie Taylor Greene has spent her time chasing headlines instead of delivering results. That's not leadership--it's abandonment. We're building something different. Being a Dirt Road Democrat is about showing up everywhere, fighting for affordable healthcare, protecting Social Security and Medicare, investing in local schools, and making sure rural Georgia has the same shot at prosperity as anyone else. body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
My grandfather spent four years in jail with Gandhi, taking on a British king and fighting for human rights. Now I’m carrying on his legacy, standing with millions to stop Trump from crushing our democratic traditions.
Before I explain, will you chip in $10 or more today to help me stand up to Trump’s radical agenda? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2026-house-fundraiser?refcode=20251024&amount=10]
DONATE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2026-house-fundraiser?refcode=20251024&amount=10]
Trump is undermining every safeguard of American democracy:
❌ Gutted Medicaid to fund billionaire tax breaks.
❌ Deployed the National Guard into U.S. cities.
❌ Deported immigrants without due process.
❌ Taxed Americans with high tariffs on all imported goods, including those like coffee that we can’t produce ourselves.
❌ Attempting to disenfranchise millions by attacking voting rights.
Americans have had enough. Seven million people took to the streets for No Kings Day on October 18, making it the second-largest single-day protest in U.S. history. They’re tired of watching Trump prove, time and time again, that one set of rules exists for the rich and powerful, and another set exists for everyone else.
https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1979590891393212874 [https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1979590891393212874]

Texas just witnessed a 135,000-person drop in voter registration, the
single biggest decline in more than a decade. Why? According to the
Houston Chronicle, it’s “because election officials are being more
aggressive in purging the rolls.”

This is on purpose and by design — and it’s only the latest attack on
voting rights. Texas is already the most voter suppressed state in the
union. With hundreds of polling places being closed down and no online or
automatic voter registration, the on-the-ground work to reach and register
voters is key to fighting back against these voter suppression efforts.

That’s where Powered by People comes in. We are out across Texas to
register, stay in touch with, and help turn out the voters who will help
decide the most consequential elections of our lifetime.

And as a grassroots organization, we’re counting on donations from

---
| | **A NOTE FROM CHRISSY**
---
| | **GOVERNMENT SHUTDOWN**
---
As I write this, we are in the midst of a government shutdown with no end in sight – all because Republicans would rather give tax breaks to the rich than provide health care to those most in need. Speaker Johnson refuses to require us ALL to be in Washington. He refuses to negotiate at ALL with Democrats. He refuses to swear in Arizona’s newly elected Representative, Adelita Grijalva – a duly elected and certified member of Congress. The GOP controls the House, the Senate, and the White House, and they could keep the doors open if they wanted to. But he and they are choosing to erode the Constitution and Congress’ Article 1 responsibilities and authorities.

Instead, they're holding firm on their reckless and dangerous budget, which will force many of my constituents to pay more than $3,000 extra for the same coverage. Republicans have been trying to overturn the Affordable Care Act since it became law in 2010. And not once with an alternative. Now more than ever, we must protect the Affordable Care Act, restore funding to Medicare and Medicaid, and stop the nonsense.
---
| | **WHAT I AND MY TEAM ARE DOING DURING THIS TIME**
---
First and foremost, we are still working. Like most public servants, we’re not getting paid either, but we’re answering the phones, following up on casework, and doing our part to end the shutdown, including:
---
* Hearing from constituents at a town hall in Downingtown
* Touring a local food bank struggling to keep food on its shelves
* Meeting with seniors in Berks County, students at Lincoln University, Black community leaders across the district, and health care workers to hear their priorities and concerns
* Showing up in Washington, D.C., to work and to testify at a hearing on the impact of the shutdown on my community
* Continuing to speak out against the many reprehensible actions of this administration

---
| | **TROOPS PAID DURING SHUTDOWN**
---
On Oct. 15, the Trump administration intervened to pay our military on time. I’m glad he did. No one, especially those who protect our national security and keep us safe, should have to work without pay. Unfortunately, this was a one-time event, and while President Trump might do so again on Oct. 30, there isn’t money to do this indefinitely.

Federal law enforcement, first responders, air traffic controllers, TSA agents, federal health workers, and, honestly, everyone who works for the federal government behind the scenes to keep our water clean, our roads clear, our food safe, our tax refunds processed, and more, deserve to be paid. Pennsylvania Democrats have been showing up in D.C. to get the government fully open for everyone – and I wish we could say the same for our Republican colleagues.
---
| | **NOVEMBER 2025 ELECTION**
---
California’s redistricting referendum is on the ballot on Nov. 4. My friend Rep. Abigail Spanberger is on the ballot for Governor in Virginia. My friend Rep. Mikie Sherrill is on the ballot for Governor in New Jersey. And in Pennsylvania, we have a slew of important local races and the all-important retention election for the state Supreme Court. The outcome of all of these races sends a message about how angry we are about the direction of our country and how willing we are to work to change things.

With all eyes on Pennsylvania, it's absolutely critical that we show up, organize, and win. But in order to get there, we need to expand our Get Out the Vote campaigns. Check out how you can make an impact by visiting **[https://www.mobilize.us/chestercountydemocraticparty](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117934652/578119657/228756271?refcode=jtk1161-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTcyZWMwYS0xNGIxLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NhZ6LLvXO4_-IVqBP7i122VOuq8EICFskrDTrNnFJOk=&emci=baed93f2-44b0-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=6972ec0a-14b1-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=21278485)** today.
---

Chrissy

## NFL Brothers by Bond, Not Blood
Tez Johnson scored his first NFL touchdown in Week 6, hauling in a 45-yard pass during the Bucs’ win over the 49ers on Oct. 12. This was just months after [reuniting with his adoptive brother](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkb2OnUAMhZ8GOl_B8LcpKNLcbtOmRB7GhlnNHSOPtYQ8fcRKeYLtbH3WJ_mc3-_LO8YU8_YLXzTzxouxLJnOksiMdGER85iSV7GdtBipRlKlxTVugLYB1y8BY7qWvg4zEznqaprbaWy7bmynvt7n0P3wE6_DFGjlid3Qjm_cTFM3MK7eYR3n29Y2rnfNPTz68Db4Fht0YeTRD1XfUIgm-viQmG0nTpd8kj5WedVp3s2OUnU_K_es3PM8z4ccpGhRcjlErdx3lXsa_YUP2XORDCcWwCCHUQB_gRfI8U8BxldMF1yEWgA3gSwn2E6XEnixHWK-V8icAHMAxlwAlWDFdAcJ0f7zAkyUYBMJUEz0AuEvdssr96x1DscZU4plnKq-2V4Y09dH9u0qPmf3LwAA__-d86Vl), Broncos quarterback Bo Nix, in the 2025 NFL Draft. Johnson, a seventh-round pick out of Oregon, caught national attention not just for his play, but for the story behind it. Years ago, Bo’s family took in Johnson during a tough stretch in high school, providing him with a stable home and a chance at a better future. [Watch an interview here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtqxDAYBODTSN0avVZ2ChWB4CZsuhBSCT1-rRW01iL_tvHtg3OFdMMMfMV83ezN5ZLn-4d7gEn3ZDFVO8O-FECEZlOt6F0pvlWcoC0IrWVoDaxg4nrh7CKUjS6XwyoaTQIQICkY3msupea9opPpvRZcJ9dDUoyHIWkewKVBRh2G-AI0m1PjTCjBztCpOFw9d8yJqJP2V6IYxIy1dT81zzhBKkfdoHWhPmgxE-JzIfKViJGIcd_37qgrrh7O_WwchonIcSPyDW5s_RyP9-070Gbic8-l5EX3RLH7w-XyR-K_v9iM-A0AAP__6Ap1Xw). The two became inseparable, eventually playing [side by side at Oregon](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOnDAQhp_GdF7B4IVL4SIN3aVNicZ4DD4Zz8aeW0KePmKVPMF1M_qkX____Xyf3zGmmNcfuJMNa5gl8JzpqIlEqMyBWRym5ArLRqUKlRKpFJqhhbvuWg1m9hjTOZvG20AE1Ddku3Ho-n7oRtNslqBdxsFhZ5a3ESAMHRrXu_5boDAghCbaK61rwUB7HTfj3-6uwxbBD2Fwd2Va8lG43D44ZtkopJOfVG4L702ym8ijqv67gknBdBzHrcYLKZgWTolWUjBxoZWzgun_JgWT0B_9wVuunLVjneNv_Znjr0_S6PkhkbOuwuXUKEL59eeQdMA9plP_k6IF9wdqh6f2lJ9ULpAXrk2x_nHElGIdRmXadceYXpXly66fFv4GAAD__4Eqmj4) as a quarterback-receiver duo. Now they’ve both landed in the NFL, turning what started as a quiet act of kindness into the league’s most heartwarming storyline. Fans and teammates alike are calling it a real-life sports movie in the making.
## Third Grader Becomes Vending Mogul
In Brooklyn’s Boerum Hill, 8-year-old Linus Piepmeyer has turned a [gumball machine into a beloved block-side](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3O4yAQRZ8Gd0R4jH9SUGzj7tt2S2swg80GQwSTRH77lfMK253RXB1d3T8_yw-GGNL2Gw8yfvML-7wk-tRIzFQWnzNbjNGWzDuVylRKoFJoAQW9bJUEvTgM8Vx044wnAuoaMu04tF03tKNudjPR1CHAuEJPerrffT-6Ce8We1Srd10TzGVrFWhQF9y0m3rbokJwgx9sL7QiFziX298cEu_k45nfVG5rPppoduZnFd0vAbOAOZ3PXPl6CZgvsYC5VV8WMMfgqfIZScB8ELGMIb2q5J3km5ILaZMHrntIJB_Xkb20JedHPJO0rxC_CZSV1kIsbcHkJLLEjeQkYG6Kcc9PiDHUYRRabQeG-K3J_73v28C_AAAA__-khJF_) business, selling NYC-themed pins he designs himself for 50 cents a pop. What began as a lesson in saving has become a fixture of the creative community, with Linus learning design, marketing, and a bit of economics along the way. See [a video posted by his mom here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU9jskZ2YQwdOFhpF-0GvZqsQ8vgMtTIYFRYjbj9qOcKk_3g6z3pPR_u4SnRNv_3K9o4R1didhueR8JSkF3MuYw-pZFzWZCPgsyEzOhAQntT8gbaBU_pcroKNiICNhVa1RnVNEZ1ulqs8rKNXWO0xHs7dTD1so8jmjjFu-xDrMi-aUqCBvketQ59OyovPQQTzdgKLTFQyVx_ZtrKgjFd-YVcT3mtkl1K2Q_R_BIwCBjO86xpO4qf2a_vh4DBJzrythPuK17IAgZGTAKG3x_P27X_-zP9VQKGim3YT0qJDtMJLefVU_qWlB_XeVn4CgAA__8PKHtK). The machine has weathered snow, graffiti, and even a baseball bat, but like Linus, it’s still standing. **Joe Khan’s fight for environmental justice is deeply personal for him.**
As a proud father of two, he wakes up every morning and asks himself the same question: _What can I do today to make the world safer for them?_
That question led him to take on big fights against corporate interests and sue 3M and DuPont for polluting Bucks County's water with PFAS, or forever chemicals. It led him to block Republican attempts to overturn the Delaware River Basin fracking ban and more. **Now it's leading him to run for District Attorney and continue the climate fight.**
As DA, Joe will investigate and prosecute corporate polluters who put profits over people. And he'll build the kind of environmental justice system Pennsylvania desperately needs.
But this race could go either way: **Donald Trump won Bucks County by 291 votes last year. This is the largest swing county in Pennsylvania, and we only have 11 days to flip it.**

clean_body: These critical elections in PA and VA could tip the balance on climate justice. | I want to tell you about two JanePAC-endorsed climate champions facing critical races on November 4th that you may not have heard about: Joe Khan for Bucks County District Attorney in Pennsylvania and Ghazala Hashmi for Lieutenant Governor in Virginia. = | = = Joe Khan’s fight for environmental justice is deeply personal for him. As a proud father of two, he wakes up every morning and asks himself the same question: What can I do today to make the world safer for them? That question led him to take on big fights against corporate interests and sue 3M and DuPont for polluting Bucks County's water with PFAS, or forever chemicals. It led him to block Republican attempts to overturn the Delaware River Basin fracking ban and more. Now it's leading him to run for District Attorney and continue the climate fight. As DA, Joe will investigate and prosecute corporate polluters who put profits over people. And he'll build the kind of environmental justice system Pennsylvania desperately needs. But this race could go either way: Donald Trump won Bucks County by 291 votes last year. This is the largest swing county in Pennsylvania, and we only have 11 days to flip it. = = Ghazala Hashmi is a proud mom, an educator, and one of the fiercest environmental champions in Virginia's State Senate. She wrote and championed the Virginia Environmental Justice Act. She fought the Atlantic Coast pipeline extension. She stood up to Virginia’s largest corporate polluter, Dominion Energy, when they wanted to build another gas plant. Now she's running to be Virginia’s next Lieutenant Governor against an opponent whose campaign received upwards of $50,000 from Dominion Energy — the same corporate polluter she's been fighting for years. This race is expected to come down to the wire, just as it did in 2022, when Republicans won the Lt. Governor seat by less than 2%. These aren't the races cable news will cover, but they're the races where your support makes the biggest difference. These positions have real power to protect communities from Big Oil and Donald Trump’s dirty fossil fuel agenda — if we elect the right people. = ✊ In solidarity, xx Jane = | Follow along: | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: Here are the facts, folks.
body:
|
#
Friend,

Unless Congress acts, the Affordable Care Act (ACA) tax credits will expire on January 1st – and that means healthcare premiums will soar, and some families could lose coverage entirely.

Here’s what that looks like in mid-Michigan alone:
* **24,000 people** will see their healthcare premiums skyrocket if Republicans let the ACA credits expire.
* The average working-class family of 4 will see a **273% increase** in their annual premiums, while a 60 year old couple will see **increases of about 212%.**
* **32,847 people** will lose health coverage due to Republican cuts to Medicaid and their plan to gut the ACA.
* **8,600 people** will completely lose access to healthcare coverage.

Families throughout MI-08 are under enough financial stress — they have been for a long time, and the MAGA agenda of tax cuts for billionaires by cutting healthcare and food for working families is making things worse.

**With costs already pushing everyday Americans to the limit, we cannot let this happen.**

Healthcare isn’t a luxury. It's the bare minimum, and it shouldn’t be treated like a hostage. I’m not going to back down from this – I’ve been working day and night to advocate for us to end this shutdown and pass a budget that protects healthcare and keeps money in your pockets – and not lining those of billionaires.

subject: I’m running for Congress!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20251024-cb.PUM-mv&refcode=em20251024-37135&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37135%2E1203867%2ENjJwdQ ]Photo of Cori Bush

Peter,

Cori Bush here.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20251024-cb.PUM-mv&refcode=em20251024-37135&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=37135%2E1203867%2ENjJwdQ ]I’m proud to share that I’m running for Congress again in Missouri’s
1st District. St. Louis needs leaders who won't fail or take orders from
billionaires. Would you consider splitting a donation between Justice
Democrats and my campaign today?

I never imagined I’d be in politics. I’m the daughter of a union
meat-cutter, a nurse for over a decade, a pastor, a survivor of gun
violence, and a formerly unhoused single mom. I know the struggle of
families who work hard and still get left out.

My fight began on the streets of Ferguson, where I stood day after day
demanding justice and caring for my neighbors after Michael Brown was
killed.

That’s what shaped me. That’s what brought me into this work. When my
community asked me to run, together we defeated a 52-year dynasty and
proved that regular people, not corporations or megadonors, could win.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20251024-cb.PUM-mv&refcode=em20251024-37135&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=37135%2E1203867%2ENjJwdQ ]That’s why I ran in the first place—and why I’m stepping up again.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20251024-cb.PUM-mv&refcode=em20251024-37135&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=37135%2E1203867%2ENjJwdQ ]Split a Donation

As you read this, families and communities are being squeezed here in St.
Louis. Groceries, rent, and utilities keep climbing, while wages stay the
same. Violence, division, and attacks on our rights are pushing us to the
breaking point.

But here’s what I know: St. Louis is built different. And so am I.

When you sent me to Washington, we moved resources home and stood up when
it mattered most: from holding the first post-pandemic hearing on Medicare
for All, to sleeping on the Capitol steps to extend the federal eviction
moratorium, standing up for our neighbors after floods and disasters, and
fighting for lower insulin prices. That’s what service looks like: helping
people where they are.

This campaign isn’t about politics; it’s about the future of St. Louis and
the special interests trying to take it away. There’s a lot at stake.
Trump and his buddies are stripping away our rights, attacking our
communities, and rigging the rules to benefit the wealthy and powerful.
Our most vulnerable will pay the price.

So, we need a fighter who truly represents us.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20251024-cb.PUM-mv&refcode=em20251024-37135&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=37135%2E1203867%2ENjJwdQ ]I stand with the people. I don’t wait for permission. I rise when it’s
hardest. Now, I’m running again to keep fighting for us. Can I count on
you to support my campaign by splitting a donation between Justice
Democrats and my campaign today?

In solidarity,

Cori Bush

body:

Hi there, **Trump is already playing defense in Arizona's 1st Congressional District.** Arizona GOP Chair Gina Swoboda just announced she's running to replace David Schweikert in AZ-01, and she's already got Trump's endorsement. That tells you everything you need to know about how worried Republicans are about losing this seat. **They should be worried.** Right now, AZ-01 is a toss-up. The district spans Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, and Fountain Hills. It’s one of the most competitive seats in the country. David Schweikert barely held on to the seat in 2024 with just 52% of the vote. **Trump knows if we win, we're one seat closer to taking back the House.** That's why he moved fast to back Swoboda before the primary even heats up. **The $50 Billion Question: Will Rural Health Get Real Reform?** By Newt Gingrich & Bobby Jindal
---
America’s rural health care system is in crisis and has been for a long time. Hospitals are closing, doctors are leaving, and patients are driving hours just to get basic care. The $50 billion Rural Health Transformation Fund in the One Big Beautiful Bill is a rare and overdue opportunity to do something about it.

But we’ve seen too many government programs hijacked by well-connected interests or squandered through short-sighted implementation. If we’re not careful, this fund will become just another bailout—a temporary fix that fails to address the underlying problems. That would be a tragic waste.

We write as two lifelong conservatives who have led at both the national and state levels. We believe in limited government, fiscal responsibility, and the power of innovation. And we believe this fund can work, but only if the focus remains on real transformation, not short-term subsidies.

The biggest mistake Washington could make is treating this as a temporary band-aid for rural hospitals reacting to the bill’s Medicaid reforms. In fact, rural hospital employment declines faster in states that implement provider taxes compared to those who don’t. That’s because the challenge facing rural health care goes beyond coverage. The system itself is not built for areas with low population density. If we’re not careful, this fund will become just another bailout—a temporary fix that fails to address the underlying problems. That would be a tragic waste. We write as two lifelong conservatives who have led at both the national and state levels. We believe in limited government, fiscal responsibility, and the power of innovation. And we believe this fund can work, but only if the focus remains on real transformation, not short-term subsidies. The biggest mistake Washington could make is treating this as a temporary band-aid for rural hospitals reacting to the bill’s Medicaid reforms. In fact, rural hospital employment declines faster in states that implement provider taxes compared to those who don’t. That’s because the challenge facing rural health care goes beyond coverage. The system itself is not built for areas with low population density. | | Email sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com by AmericaNext

Hi, it’s Oregon Secretary of State, Tobias Read.
The message coming from Oregonians couldn’t be clearer: There are no kings in the United States of America.
But Washington still doesn’t get it.
They’ve demanded Oregon’s voter data and private information that belongs to you, not to any federal agency looking to intimidate voters or meddle in our elections. And now, they’ve sent troops into Portland to “restore order.”
Let’s call this what it is: a power grab by bullies who think they’re kings.
When federal authorities start targeting states for defending democracy, it’s not “law and order” — it’s an assault on our rights. And here in Oregon, we won’t stand for it.
As your Secretary of State, I’ve sworn an oath to protect the integrity of our elections, and that means keeping your voter data safe, your rights intact, and your voice heard. But this fight can’t be waged from my office alone. It needs a chorus of Oregonians who refuse to be silenced or surveilled.
So I’m asking you to stand with me: Add your name to the petition demanding that the federal government back off and respect Oregon’s sovereignty. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gfmfVa9JykGYDHOsVzs0jg2]
https://secure.ngpvan.com/gfmfVa9JykGYDHOsVzs0jg2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gfmfVa9JykGYDHOsVzs0jg2]
They can send troops. They can threaten. They can demand our data. But they cannot take our freedom to vote, to protest, or to govern ourselves.
This is Oregon. We answer to the people — not to kings.
Thank you,
Tobias Read
Oregon Secretary of State

Peter,

Election Day is just around the corner, and we still have a lot of work to do from now until Nov. 4th!

We need help to make sure every Pennsylvanian knows their voting plan—where they’ll vote, when they plan to vote, and how they are voting in this election. _To do that, we need your help!_

[Join us EVERY DAY — Monday through Friday from 6-8:00 p.m., Saturdays and Sundays from 1-3:00 p.m. — with an autodialer as we call folks to GET OUT THE VOTE for our Democratic PA Supreme Court Justices — Christine Donohue, Kevin Dougherty, and David Wecht!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117938571/578132342/3761665?source=EM_NBI_PADM_20251024_EN_Phonebanks_0_1MO_PaDems_NA_NA_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjRjMzg3Zi0xZmIxLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CQ7Pz-iwCPDgJw3w4USKSHP27E0WaY6KVqs35Xj40ac=&emci=61517e30-17b1-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=0f4c387f-1fb1-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=25616296) | | **[SIGN UP!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117938576/578132346/3761665?source=EM_NBI_PADM_20251024_EN_Phonebanks_0_1MO_PaDems_NA_NA_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ3MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjRjMzg3Zi0xZmIxLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CQ7Pz-iwCPDgJw3w4USKSHP27E0WaY6KVqs35Xj40ac=&emci=61517e30-17b1-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=0f4c387f-1fb1-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=25616296)**

# Trump administration seeking death penalty for accused Iryna Zarutska murderer
Attorney General Pam Bondi **[announced Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/3c898a23-e9e3-4faa-b822-e96aab028002?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that federal prosecutors will pursue capital punishment against the man accused of fatally stabbing Ukrainian refugee Iryna Zarutska on a Charlotte transit train in August.
* **A huge wrap sheet:** Decarlos Brown Jr., a 34-year-old homeless man with extensive criminal and mental health records, faces federal charges for murdering Zarutska on public transportation after approaching her from behind and stabbing her three times in what appeared to be an unprovoked attack. **[Brown](https://substack.com/redirect/58402b26-0c9b-4992-a753-802aae85b863?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , who has a schizophrenia diagnosis, had been arrested 14 times prior to the killing and was free on a written promise to appear following a January arrest for misusing the 911 system.
"I plan on signing a warrant to seek the death penalty in that case," Bondi told Fox News host Jesse Watters.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5d78fd27-6272-4615-a584-a076cdd3aeac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Video footage captured Brown allegedly saying "I got that white girl"** after the attack as Zarutska bled to death on the train floor while bystanders attempted to help her. A federal judge appointed Joshua Kendrick, an attorney with capital punishment experience, to represent Brown in September. The Trump administration has attributed Zarutska's death to lenient criminal justice policies that allowed Brown to remain free despite his history.
* **Brown also faces state murder charges carrying potential death penalty eligibility,** though local prosecutors have not indicated whether they will seek capital punishment at the state level. The case has intensified national debate over bail reform and the handling of defendants with serious mental illness and extensive criminal backgrounds.

# **DOJ warns California Democrats against arresting ICE agents**
Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche **[sent a letter Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/f8bfc1c4-c42a-48c2-8997-9f5d8aab75ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to Rep. Nancy Pelosi, Gov. Gavin Newsom, Attorney General Rob Bonta, and San Francisco DA Brooke Jenkins, warning them against engaging in an "apparent criminal conspiracy" to arrest Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents performing their duties.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f8bfc1c4-c42a-48c2-8997-9f5d8aab75ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Pelosi suggested local arrests for federal agents:** The warning came after Pelosi suggested Wednesday that local police could arrest ICE agents if they violate state laws during immigration enforcement operations, with Pelosi and Rep. Kevin Mullin claiming in a joint statement that "our state and local authorities may arrest federal agents if they break California law."
* **DOJ threatens prosecution of state officials:** Blanche stated the Justice Department would "investigate and prosecute any state or local official" who violates federal statutes or directs others to interfere with federal law enforcement, calling any arrests of federal agents "both illegal and futile" under numerous federal laws prohibiting interference with immigration operations.
* **Document preservation ordered:** The deputy AG ordered California officials to "preserve all written and electronic communications and records related to any attempts or efforts to impede or obstruct federal law enforcement officials," urging them to "publicly abandon this apparent criminal conspiracy" and stop threatening law enforcement.

## CDC Establishes New Workgroup to Study the Safety of Aluminum in Childhood Vaccines
By James Lyons-Weiler, Science and Medicine Contributor, _[The MAHA Report](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=CjIPhRT4CzYYH7usCPIijxK54GDZUZAqQjCCk5hNXuc&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maha_report_251024_segment_id&n=2)_ The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), through its Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP), has established the Childhood and Adolescent Immunization Schedule Workgroup with **a mandate to study aluminum adjuvants – salts – in some vaccines given to children.**
---
[ ](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=CjIPhRT4CzYYH7usCPIijwPT9w3EQQ61ndLm2qnONVQonBVPant3o1KbWAvBoTJXxNwK33h7doiUxkn36o6cy0Ioqrxu8Iw2a_5IS_gGYek&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maha_report_251024_segment_id&n=3)
---
As of October 8, 2025, CDC’s [newly revised Terms of Reference (ToR)](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=IGdGkSTmqeqwNnjWiNfgmgcwIhF2E6_gtlT7H1yvKOiqxllzqElvg-VTQRNz2IUNCtJ2obOsbt2ntFuCfmNhfQ&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maha_report_251024_segment_id&n=4) include ingredient-specific safety evaluations, with a direct focus on aluminum adjuvants and associated risks, including asthma. The updated Terms of Reference asks: “Do either of the two different aluminum adjuvants increase the risk of asthma?” This language marks the first formal acknowledgment by ACIP that aluminum hydroxide and aluminum phosphate, the primary adjuvants in most pediatric vaccines, may merit differentiated toxicological scrutiny. This change places the issue within the Workgroup’s formal priority and scope, **not as a fringe or side issue.**

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. name: Susan M. Michael, International Christian Embassy Jerusalem - USA
subject: The sirens sound. You have seconds
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.
-------------------------

[International Christian Embassy Jerusalem]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

Friend,

The time it takes you to read this email is the same amount of warning
an Israeli family in Jerusalem may have when rockets are launched,
JUST 90 SECONDS TO REACH SAFETY.

Ninety seconds to scoop up a sleeping child.

Ninety seconds to steady an elderly parent.

Ninety seconds to pray the shelter door closes before the rockets
hit.

Worse still, families living along the Gaza, Syrian, and Lebanese
borders have even _LESS TIME TO REACH SAFETY, JUST 15 SECONDS. _

_And for 2.6 MILLION ISRAELIS, NEARLY 30% OF THE POPULATION, THERE
ISN’T EVEN A FUNCTIONAL BOMB SHELTER NEARBY. _

This is why the International Christian Embassy Jerusalem (ICEJ) has
placed over 250 bomb shelters in vulnerable communities and provided
trauma counseling for hundreds of anxious children. We have also
assisted community leaders and first responders as they seek to
protect and serve their people.

All of this assistance has brought such hope and encouragement to a
battered nation. But there is so much more we need to do.

PLEASE, GIVE GENEROUSLY TO THE INTERNATIONAL CHRISTIAN EMBASSY
JERUSALEM USA. WHETHER IT’S $25, $50, $100, OR WHATEVER GOD PLACES
ON YOUR HEART, YOUR GIFT WILL GO TO WORK IMMEDIATELY WHERE IT'S NEEDED
MOST ACROSS ALL OF OUR VITAL PROGRAMS.
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

GIVE NOW – BE THEIR REFUGE
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

When missiles and drones are shot at Israel, sirens interrupt sleep,
school lessons, family dinners, and moments of prayer. Parents live
with constant anxiety. Grandparents who endured past wars now watch
their children and grandchildren face the same terror and worry
greatly about their future.

But your compassion brings relief and hope.

Here’s how your gift makes an immediate difference:

* REBUILDING COMMUNITIES destroyed in the October 7 attacks, helping
families start over.

* PROTECTIVE VESTS AND GEAR for volunteer security teams on the
front lines 24/7.

* TRAUMA COUNSELING for children who wake from nightmares, and
training for more counselors to meet overwhelming needs.

* BASIC AID — food, clothing, and essentials for struggling
families across Israel.

* ADVOCACY - standing against antisemitism around the world bring
the people of Israel great encouragement and hope.

PLEASE, GIVE $25, $50, OR EVEN $100 NOW TO THE INTERNATIONAL CHRISTIAN
EMBASSY JERUSALEM USA. EVERY DOLLAR WILL PROVIDE PROTECTION, COMFORT,
AND RESTORATION WHERE IT'S NEEDED MOST.
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

STAND WITH ISRAEL TODAY – GIVE NOW
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

Since our founding in 1980, the International Christian Embassy
Jerusalem has stood with Israel through war, terror, and disaster.

We have helped bring tens of thousands of Jewish people home through
Aliyah, comforted Holocaust Survivors, placed hundreds of bomb
shelters, and provided aid for victims of terror.

Our USA branch connects Christians like you to this sacred mission.
Together, we are answering God’s call to “Comfort, yes, comfort My
people!” (Isaiah 40:1).

But today, the need is urgent. Sirens are still sounding. Rockets are
falling. Families are still running for cover, with only seconds to
spare.

Children carry trauma for a lifetime. Communities once thriving are
left in ruins, vulnerable to despair and further attack.

Hate-filled lies are raging around the world blaming Israel for
everything!

THAT STORY CAN BE CHANGED, AND YOU ARE THE ONE WHO CHANGES IT.

PLEASE, GIVE GENEROUSLY TO THE INTERNATIONAL CHRISTIAN EMBASSY
JERUSALEM USA. YOUR GIFT OF $25, $50, $100, OR ANY AMOUNT GOD PLACES
ON YOUR HEART WILL BRING COMFORT, PROTECTION, AND HOPE WHERE IT'S
NEEDED MOST.
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

BE THE ANSWER THEY ARE PRAYING FOR – GIVE NOW
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/718032580c2e4c789c44f544edd9704c-2996a81c7cb74dbba48adc57961f23b9/63]

For Zion’s sake,

Susan M. Michael
International Christian Embassy Jerusalem USA President

P.S. By the time you finish reading this, an Israeli family has
already used up their 90 seconds. Your gift ensures protection,
comfort, and hope where it's needed most. PLEASE DON’T WAIT, BE THE
ANSWER TO THEIR PRAYER NOW.

Dear Patriot, Hours after taking office, President Trump righted one of the worst miscarriages of justice I’ve witnessed in my decades in law enforcement by pardoning DC Officer Terence Sutton. **[Today, I’m asking you to help me right another injustice in this case – on behalf of Deputy U.S. Marshal Cory Novick, a government witness at Officer Sutton’s trial.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Please allow me to explain... Officer Terence Sutton was attempting to pull over a known gang member for illegal activity. The suspect fled on his scooter and drove straight into oncoming traffic. He was hit by a civilian vehicle and passed away from his injuries. **The DC anti-police mob went crazy.** They blamed Officer Sutton for the accident, smeared him as a racist, and pressured federal prosecutors to charge him with Second-Degree Murder, which they did. The prosecution’s case relied on portraying Officer Sutton’s conduct as reckless and indifferent – and they called on Deputy Cory Novick to testify along their party line. But Cory is a man of integrity and honor. He served as a DC police officer, a Calvert County Deputy Sheriff, and a Deputy U.S. Marshal with no history of misconduct. He took the stand and swore an oath to tell the truth – and that’s exactly what Cory did. In fact, he was called and recalled several times during the course of the months-long trial. He told the truth. But his truthful testimony did not support the prosecution’s politically motivated narrative. **The government was furious – even though the anti-cop jury still found Officer Sutton guilty...** ...and without any disciplinary action or a single incident on his record, Biden’s _U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of Columbia_ abruptly added Cory to the “Lewis List.” **[If you know what the Lewis List is – then you know why I’m asking you to help Cory.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** You see, this blacklist is a secretive designation of law enforcement officers whose credibility the government claims is impaired. Placement on that list ended Cory’s service with the Marshals. He was never given notice. Never given a hearing. Never even told the factual basis for the action. [**Will you help Deputy Cory Novick restore his good name by donating $35, $50, $100, or more?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) My name is Jason Johnson. I’m the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). For over 30 years, LELDF has helped wrongly accused or convicted officers clear their names and get their lives back. We’ve supported scores of men and women through trials, appeals, administrative proceedings, and even presidential pardons. But I can’t think of a time when we’ve been called in to help an officer who was blacklisted for telling the truth. The truth! It goes to show how low the progressive prosecutors overtaking this country will go to wage their war on cops. And that’s why your support today is so important. Cory has a great team of attorneys and I’m optimistic about their ability to get this terrible injustice undone, especially with President Trump in office and Pam Bondi his Attorney General. But with several major trials underway for our other officers, I need to make sure LELDF has the resources to pay for Cory’s defense. **[That’s why I’m asking you to give just $35, $50, $100, or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** What Biden’s DOJ did to Cory was retaliation. Plain and simple. That is not justice. That is politics. And it sends a chilling message to every law enforcement officer who might be called to the stand. Thank you in advance for standing with Deputy Marshal Cory Novick and the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.

name: Squad Victory Fund
subject: You asked. We’re answering:
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20251024-1590-foote&t=1001&akid=1590%2E342411%2EStCjdU ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

We recently asked you to send in your questions about the Squad, our
campaigns, and the movement we’re building together. And wow — you spoke
loud and clear.

The last few weeks have been intense. Government shutdowns,
gerrymandering, ICE raids, and attacks on our democracy. The stakes have
never been higher.

But what your questions overwhelmingly demonstrate is that the people
aren’t scared. No, the people are ready to fight. Together, we can turn
fear into action.

We wanted to take a moment to answer a few of the questions we received
most often:

Stephen from North Carolina asked: Will you commit to holding everyone and
anyone accountable for their actions, decisions, and failure to comply
with the Constitution, including but not limited to the Supreme Court?

Absolutely. Democracy only works when the powerful are held accountable,
from local officials to the highest courts in the land. The Squad fights
tirelessly to make sure laws and the Constitution aren’t optional.
Alexandria has exposed corporate influence in Congress and challenged
authoritarian overreach in immigration policy. Ayanna has stood up against
systemic injustices in policing and budget priorities that hurt working
families. Ilhan consistently calls out corruption and the misuse of power
in foreign policy and federal spending. Rashida has pushed back against
voter suppression and other attacks on the democratic process. Every vote,
every campaign, every protest is part of that accountability. We refuse to
let anyone place themselves above the people, and together, we keep up the
pressure where it matters most.

Larry from Texas asked: How can we counteract the GOP’s gerrymandering?

We fight back through grassroots organizing and supporting independent
redistricting efforts to bring balance back to the maps. Every community
meeting and volunteer effort strengthens the movement. Gerrymandering
works only when people sit back — and people-powered work is how we
reclaim democracy and make every vote count.

Abbie from California asked: What can we do to get ICE off our streets?

We fight to protect our communities — and the first step is taking a
stand. Across the country, people are showing incredible courage:
neighbors are putting their bodies on the line and raising their voices to
protect one another from deportation, community members are documenting
ICE raids and sharing their stories to hold authorities accountable, and
volunteers are walking families to safety or accompanying them to
appointments so they aren’t targeted. These acts take real personal risk,
but they make a difference and can save lives. You can take action too:
speak out safely in your neighborhoods, connect with local immigrant
advocacy groups, and organize with your neighbors to demand policies that
prioritize safety over raids. This is how we push back against ICE,
protect our neighbors, and build communities that are safe, strong, and
resilient.

Beatriz from Georgia asked: How can we convince voters to call their
representatives?

Start with the people you know. Talk to your friends, family, neighbors,
and coworkers about why this fight matters. Ask them to take action, and
then ask them to bring someone else along. Invite them to make calls, send
emails, or attend town halls with you. Every conversation, every shared
story, creates a chain of people-powered pressure that politicians can’t
ignore. Change doesn’t happen when we wait for someone else to lead — it
happens when communities organize through their relationships, turning
connections into collective action, and making sure every voice is heard.
That’s how we build real power, together.

Your questions aren’t just questions — they’re a blueprint for action.
They show us that change happens when people speak out and hold power
accountable. By supporting our progressive leaders, taking action in our
communities, and refusing to let injustice go unchallenged, we build a
movement that can win real, lasting progressive change.

In these uncertain times, the Squad Victory Fund is standing with you.
We’re taking a stand, turning fear into power, and building a movement
that cannot be ignored.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20251024-movement.HpMvh7&refcode=em20251024-1590&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1590%2E342411%2EStCjdU ]We can’t do it without you. Will you chip in $3 to
ensure the Squad has the resources to fight back against corporate
interests, defend our communities, and continue the fight for progressive
change?

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20251024-movement.HpMvh7&refcode=em20251024-1590&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=1590%2E342411%2EStCjdU ]Contribute ››

Thank you for asking, organizing, and standing up. Together, we fight.
Together, we win.

In solidarity,

The Squad Victory Fund

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.squadvictoryfund.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1590%2E342411%2EStCjdU

Paid for by The Squad Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

In addition to what’s legally required, The Squad Victory Fund does not accept contributions from: (1) corporations, associations, or their PACs; (2) individuals registered as federal lobbyists or under FARA; (3) from the PACs, lobbyists, or SEC-named executives of fossil fuel companies; or (4) from the Fraternal Order of Police.

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated equally among: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

To contribute via check, please address to The Squad Victory Fund c/o MBA Consulting Group, PO Box 15845, Washington D.C., 20003

Email us: info@squadvictoryfund.com

ICE working to remove criminal illegal aliens.

> As the mainstream media continues to ignore the benefits of the
> Trump administration’s crackdown on illegal immigration, federal
> agents keep arresting murderers, rapists, drug traffickers, gang
> members, and child sex predators welcomed into the United States or
> released from local jails under Biden. The Department of Homeland
> Security (DHS) is making it easy to cover these important operations
> by spoon feeding reluctant news organizations detailed information
> about the perpetrators, complete with criminal records and mug shots
> though the establishment press focuses solely on the suffering that
> deportations are causing in migrant communities throughout the
> country. The reality is that Immigration and Customs Enforcement
> (ICE) is making communities throughout America safer by ridding them
> of heinous criminals protected under the previous administration and
> by local governments that offer illegal aliens sanctuary.
>
> In one of the agency’s most recent operations, over 1,400 criminal
> aliens
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77371&L=36331&F=T&&hash=b0526a6480a65d3bd03fd6d121f9f01bbec6dd0dc3fca2a53db127406d7d6d6b]
> were arrested in just three weeks in September. They were all
> rounded up in Massachusetts, a state that has long offered illegal
> immigrants sanctuary and forbids local law enforcement agencies from
> assisting or cooperating with federal immigration authorities. More
> than 600 of the migrants arrested have significant criminal
> convictions or criminal charges for crimes committed in the U.S. or
> are known foreign fugitives. Some are members of the famously
> violent Mara Salvatrucha (MS-13), Tren de Aragua and 18th Street
> gangs. David Wesling, the ICE Enforcement and Removal Operations
> (ERO) director in Boston that spearheaded the recent operation
> confirms that the illegal aliens had “significant criminality in
> the United States or abroad.” Wesling explains that the effort
> nabbed “criminal offenders who victimized innocent people and
> traumatized entire communities—murderers, rapists, drug
> traffickers, child sex predators and members of violent
> transnational criminal gangs.” He adds that “all made the
> mistake of attempting to undermine U.S. immigration law by hiding
> out in Massachusetts.”
>
> The arrested include a 53-year-old man, Jose Orellana-Pena, from El
> Salvador with rape, assault, and battery convictions. A 34-year-old
> from India, Raj Kumar Sah, has been charged with enticement of a
> child to engage in prostitution/human trafficking or commercial sex
> and assault and battery on a person over 14. A 24-year-old
> Guatemalan, Anderson Hernandez-Vasquez, was convicted of raping a
> child and served a two-year sentence in Woburn before being released
> back into the community instead of being deported. A 47-year-old
> from El Salvador, Mauricio Eguizabal-Ovalle, has been charged with
> seven counts of assault and battery, three counts of statutory rape
> and six counts of assault and battery on a child under 14. Manuel
> Antonio Rivera-Eraso, a 35-year-old Honduran, has been charged with
> four counts of rape of a child and possession of child pornography
> as well as indecent assault and battery on a child. A 65-year-old
> from Laos, Souvanheuang Phachansiri, was convicted of second-degree
> murder and kidnapping and 21-year-old Guatemalan Perfecto
> Nolasco-Lopez has convictions for assault and battery on a child,
> strangulation/suffocation, and kidnapping.
>
> The September Massachusetts operation exposed the grave consequences
> of sanctuary policies and the urgent need for local leaders to
> prioritize the safety of their residents over politics, according to
> ICE Director Todd M. Lyons. “Every illegal alien we arrested
> during the operation was breaking U.S. immigration law, and hundreds
> were violent criminals who should never have been allowed to roam
> freely in our communities,” Lyons said. “Local law enforcement

Hi Peter, it’s Rep. Mark Takano.
As a teacher for more than 20 years, I’m devastated by Donald Trump’s proposal to slash education funding by **15%**.
His new budget is not only shortsighted, Peter – it’s cruel.
This proposal eliminates federal funding from essential programs that hire qualified teachers, feed low-income students, and provide behavioral support to students that need it.
What’s more, it clearly targets schools in Democratic districts – which will experience an additional $10 million of funding cuts compared to their Republican counterparts. It’s partisan and sickening.
[**I’m fighting to protect public education and block this backwards budget proposal, but I need your support to keep up this fight. Keep reading to learn more, or if you’re able, chip in $5 or anything you can to fund my re‐election campaign. >>**](https://marktakano.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224eb2c898a465decdda4691f&id=117a298681&e=9a636fd341)

| |
This is personal for me, Peter.
From an early age, I saw the power that education had to transform the lives of the people around me, and that inspired me to become a public school teacher after graduation – a position I held for more than two decades.
As a teacher, I saw firsthand how inequality shapes a child’s outcomes, driving my belief that government assistance is essential in our public schools.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://marktakano.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224eb2c898a465decdda4691f&id=bf9849a699&e=9a636fd341)
| |
Trump’s funding cuts will mean larger class sizes, fewer teachers, and the elimination of programs that feed, educate, and protect the most vulnerable children across the nation.
And at a time when a third of K-12 students are behind grade level already, _**these cuts will be catastrophic for the next generation, Peter.**_
I believe that investing in our future starts with investing in students, which is why I will continue to advocate for legislation that gives our schools, teachers, and students the proper resources they need to succeed.
[**But Peter, I need your support to block this budget and continue to fight back against Donald Trump’s agenda. So can I count on you to donate to my campaign today to help me continue advocating for public education? >>**](https://marktakano.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224eb2c898a465decdda4691f&id=e46e16c4c1&e=9a636fd341)

Thank you for standing with me, Peter.
Rep. Mark Takano
